description: Connect Simply Asking to ask questions about your organization's documents, records, and confirmed business facts. Get grounded answers with source references from content your account is allowed to access. Requires a Simply Asking account. This integration provides read-only knowledge access; questions count toward your Simply Asking plan's AI usage.

defaultPrompt: What does our onboarding guide say a new team member should do first? Include sources.
Who approves purchase requests according to our company policies? Cite the source.
How does our team handle an urgent support request? Summarize the documented steps and sources.
